caseName: Colorado River Water Conservation District v. Four Counties Water Users Ass'n
caseNameFull: Colorado River Water Conservation District v. Four Counties Water Users Association
attorneys: Kenneth Balcomb, Edward Mulhall, Jr., and Robert L. McCarty for petitioners., Clarence L. Ireland for Four Counties Water Users Association, and J. Fred Schneider for Matheson, respondents., Solicitor General Griswold filed a memorandum for the United States, by invitation of the Court, ante, p. 924.
judges: Are, Black, Consideration, Granted, Should, Took

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Colo. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Fortas are of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
